topics.topic: Exact membership of SOURCE_FORMATS and signature definitions for additional formats
questions: Does `SOURCE_FORMATS` contain exactly `JPEG`, `PNG` and `WEBP`, or all format names supported by the image library in addition to those three; and, if it contains more, where are their required signature rows defined?

quotes: | `SOURCE_FORMATS` | `tuple[str, ...]` | `JPEG`, `PNG`, `WEBP`, the format names of the image library |

`SOURCE_SIGNATURES` holds the signature of each format of `SOURCE_FORMATS`, keyed by `format` and `offset`; a
format's signature is found when every row of that format finds its `signature`, written in lowercase
hexadecimal, at its byte `offset` from the start of the file.

| `format` | `offset` | `signature` |
|---|---|---|
| `JPEG` | 0 | `ffd8ff` |
| `PNG` | 0 | `89504e470d0a1a0a` |
| `WEBP` | 0 | `52494646` |
| `WEBP` | 8 | `57454250` |
judgement.why: The constant lists JPEG, PNG and WEBP as the image-library format names in scope, and the signature table supplies the required rows for each of those formats.
